conflicts.why: Full clamping force within 1.5 s versus no later than 1.0 s.
Holding on 30 % slopes versus a maximum of 20 %.
At least 6 m/s² versus limited to 4 m/s².
Only with a fastened seat belt versus regardless of the seat belt. No numbers.
1500 daN is 15 kN, below the required 18 kN.

decoys.why: Red lamp for applied, yellow lamp for a fault. Different states.
Works from 9 V, and stores a fault below 9 V. Consistent.

texts.EPB-R-010: When the driver pulls the EPB switch, the full clamping force shall be reached within 1.5 s.
texts.EPB-R-011: The full clamping force shall be reached no later than 1.0 s after the EPB switch is pulled.
texts.EPB-R-012: The EPB shall hold the fully loaded vehicle on slopes of up to 30 %.
texts.EPB-R-013: The maximum slope on which the EPB shall hold the fully loaded vehicle is 20 %.
texts.EPB-R-014: A red warning lamp shall be shown in the instrument cluster while the EPB is applied.
texts.EPB-R-015: The EPB shall release fast when the driver presses the EPB switch.
texts.EPB-R-016: The EPB shall re-clamp with adequate force after the brake discs have cooled down.
texts.EPB-R-021: The EPB actuators shall be mounted on the rear brake calipers.
texts.EPB-R-022: If the EPB switch is held while driving, the EPB shall decelerate the vehicle with at least 6 m/s².
texts.EPB-R-024: The automatic drive-away release shall only be available when the driver's seat belt is fastened.
texts.EPB-R-026: Each EPB actuator shall generate a clamping force of at least 18 kN.
texts.EPB-R-027: The EPB shall apply automatically when the vehicle has been stationary with the engine off for 3 min.
texts.EPB-R-028: The EPB shall work at supply voltages from 9 V to 16 V.
texts.EPB-R-029: The EPB control unit shall store a fault when the supply voltage stays below 9 V for more than 500 ms.
texts.EPB-R-030: The instrument cluster shall show the message "Parking brake applied" when the vehicle is switched off.
texts.EPB-R-031: The actuators shall operate as quietly as possible.
texts.EPB-R-032: An audible warning shall be clearly noticeable when the driver leaves the vehicle with the EPB released.
texts.EPB-R-033: A yellow warning lamp shall be shown in the instrument cluster when an EPB fault is detected.
texts.EPB-R-034: The EPB shall provide a service mode that retracts the pistons for brake pad replacement.
texts.EPB-R-041: During dynamic braking with the EPB switch, the deceleration shall be limited to 4 m/s².
texts.EPB-R-043: The automatic drive-away release shall work regardless of the seat belt status.
texts.EPB-R-045: The clamping force of each EPB actuator shall not exceed 1500 daN.
texts.EPB-R-047: The EPB shall apply automatically after the vehicle has stood still with the engine off for 120 s.
texts.EPB-R-048: The EPB shall work safely in all foreseeable situations.
texts.EPB-R-049: After a temporary undervoltage, the EPB shall be available again within a short time.
texts.EPB-R-050: The EPB shall only be released manually when the brake pedal is pressed.
